address.ambiguity: counts placeholders ('0 MAIN ST') and road-only situs as filled

parcel_id.ambiguity: no format check: a mis-parsed value counts as filled; NC OneMap is reached by a SPATIAL point lookup (enrichment_parcel_from_geo.py), not gis_fill.py -- that module's own queries are keyed BY parcel_id (where parno/altparno IN ...), so it structurally cannot discover one that's missing. 'existing enrichers' for a parcel_id backfill means parcel_from_geo, never gis_fill (2026-10-16 gap-sweep)

owner_name.ambiguity: the name may come from a court caption or notice, not the tax roll

phone.ambiguity: includes phones from NC lien-agent appointment filings (liensnc) and voter-file name matches; not every phone is proven to be the owner's

email.ambiguity: a wrapper with no best_email is not counted (correct); emails come from notices and filings only

sqft.ambiguity: counts footprint x stories ESTIMATES (living_sqft_estimated) as filled; 10/1 divided by all rows, land included

beds_baths.ambiguity: 10/1 divided by all rows, vacant land included

assessed_value.ambiguity: market_value can be a model value, not the county's assessment

comps.doc: raw.comps (lazy-detail sidecar) is a non-empty list
comps.ambiguity: any comp counts, including kind-only matches across a whole county

comps_tight.doc: at least one comp whose match_quality has both +sqft and +beds

lt_foreclosure_sale.doc: listing_type == foreclosure_sale; applies in the owner's flip scope (18 footprint counties + oceanfront beach-drive counties)

lt_sheriff_sale.doc: listing_type == sheriff_sale; applies in the owner's flip scope (18 footprint counties + oceanfront beach-drive counties)
lt_sheriff_sale.ambiguity: NC forecloses by trustee/clerk, SC by Master-in-Equity; sheriff execution sales of land are rare, so 0 is expected

lt_auction.doc: listing_type == auction; applies in the owner's flip scope (18 footprint counties + oceanfront beach-drive counties)

lt_reo.doc: listing_type == reo; applies in the owner's flip scope (18 footprint counties + oceanfront beach-drive counties)

lt_hoa_sale.doc: listing_type == hoa_sale; applies in the owner's flip scope (18 footprint counties + oceanfront beach-drive counties)
lt_hoa_sale.ambiguity: 10/2 note: a working source exists but its rows are typed foreclosure_sale

lt_tax_sale_overage.ambiguity: SC counties publish excess-funds lists; NC clerks hold surplus without a published list

multi_year_delinquent_tax.doc: raw.multi_year_delinquent_tax present; checked = the tax roll was read (any property-tax block on the row)

repeat_tax_loss.doc: raw.repeat_tax_loss present; checked = tax roll read

heir_estate.doc: raw.heir_estate present (a parcel owner-of-record naming heirs/estate)

heir_naming_publication.ambiguity: SC: Column estate lane; NC: Column notices searched by text (nc_heir_notices); 75 of 100 NC counties have a Column paper

divorce_no_subsequent_deed.doc: raw.divorce_no_subsequent_deed present; applies to divorce rows; checked = resolved_from_name present
divorce_no_subsequent_deed.ambiguity: NC-only: the producer hard-skips every SC row (enrichment_sc_divorce.py went statewide 2026-10-07, after this Spec assumed SC family court was access-restricted; 2026-10-17 gap-sweep)

marriage_license.ambiguity: 10/1 counts the {'status': 'no_match'} wrapper as a hit; the second view counts only a found license; enrichment_marriage_license.py (the original producer) was retired 2026-10-09 -- live coverage is the 6 Cott counties enrichment_register_checks.py's marriage-index search reaches. Buncombe has none: its only marriage lane depended on the retired module, and enrichment_aumentum_rod.py's own fetch discards the marriage rows it already pulls (2026-10-16 gap-sweep)

bankruptcy_stay.doc: raw.bankruptcy_stay present; applies to a FORECLOSURE-class row with a bankruptcy match (not a standalone bankruptcy lead)
bankruptcy_stay.ambiguity: the shared 'bankrupt' tag over-applied here ~70x (includes every listing_type=='bankruptcy' row itself, which the real producer always skips); narrowed to its own applies rule 2026-10-17 gap-sweep

bankruptcy_tax_combo.doc: raw.bankruptcy_tax_combo present; checked = tax roll read

vacant_lot.doc: raw.vacant_lot present; checked = a land-use value is on the row

storm_damage.doc: raw.storm_damage present (post-Helene damage-assessment layers); applies only to counties with a FEMA Helene IA registration
storm_damage.ambiguity: applied to all 437,170 rows statewide until 2026-10-17 (a 392,412-row false gap: Helene structural damage cannot occur in a county the storm never reached). Narrowed to storm_scope -- the real FEMA IA-declared footprint (~71 counties), broader than the 3 the producer currently covers on purpose, so still-unbuilt in-footprint counties stay visible as a real gap rather than being hidden along with the out-of-footprint ones

liens.doc: raw.liens present; checked = a register-of-deeds pull is on the row (raw.rod)

child_support.doc: raw.child_support present; applies to rows with a court case

lien_priority.doc: raw.lien_priority present; applies to rows with a register pull

jail_booking.doc: raw.jail_booking present = a positive roster match; checked = a hit OR a healthy roster that matched nobody (raw.jail_booking_screen, a separate key so a no-match wrapper is never misread by _gate_jail as an active booking)
jail_booking.ambiguity: counts released bookings and every confidence level

incarceration.doc: raw.incarceration present; checked = incarceration or incarceration_check
incarceration.ambiguity: incarceration_check ({'result': 'no_match'}) is a negative record; 10/1 rightly ignores it for hits; here it counts as 'checked'

bop_federal.doc: raw.bop_federal present; checked = bop_federal or bop_check

liensnc_posthumous_filing.doc: raw.liensnc_posthumous_filing present; applies to NC rows with a liensnc filing

sos_dissolution.doc: raw.sos_dissolution present = a positive dissolution/suspension hit; checked = an SoS lookup is on the row, hit or not (sos_agent, sos_dissolution or sos_screen -- the last one is the active/unknown negative result, a separate key from the positive hit so a clean entity is never misread as dissolved)

title_risk.doc: raw.title_risk present; applies to foreclosure-type rows
title_risk.ambiguity: 60% of title_risk blocks are kind 'unknown' (no senior/junior call)

owner_mismatch.doc: raw.owner_mismatch present; applies to rows with a defendant

notice_service_defect.doc: raw.notice_service_defect present; checked = notice text on the row
notice_service_defect.ambiguity: NC-only: the producer hard-skips every SC row -- SC's delinquent-tax process is purely administrative, no lawsuit/docket/service event exists to have a defect in (live-verified; 2026-10-17 gap-sweep)

two_year_delinquent.doc: raw.two_year_delinquent.is_two_year_plus is true; checked = tax roll read

tax_aging_surfaced.doc: raw.tax_aging_surfaced.status != 'current' and years_delinquent > 0; checked = tax roll read

divorce.doc: raw.divorce.case_count > 0 or cases non-empty; checked = the divorce wrapper is present

probate.doc: raw.probate names a decedent, es_case_number or nc_estate_file_no

vacancy.ambiguity: a code-officer vacant-structure registry is a rare open-data product; only these 3 tiny city/county sources exist in all of NC+SC (2026-10-17 gap-sweep)

code_enforcement.doc: raw.code_enforcement condemned/has_open/severe (or True); checked = wrapper present

deed_chain_has_history.doc: raw.deed_chain is a dict (history fetched; not a distress signal)
deed_chain_has_history.ambiguity: a dict with an empty transfers list counts as history

deed_chain_break.doc: raw.deed_chain.summary.chain_breaks truthy; checked = deed chain present

deed_chain_distress_transfer.doc: raw.deed_chain.summary.distress_transfers truthy; checked = deed chain present

atty_legal_description.doc: legal_description, or a legal field in raw.gis_attrs_full / mcdowell_probate

atty_deed_ref.doc: a deed book+page (or instrument no.) in deed_chain, gis.last_sale, rod, nc_rod, rod_docs, gis_attrs_full or mcdowell_probate

atty_taxpayer_of_record.doc: a name read from the tax roll/parcel record: gis.owner, owner_mailing.owner, qpaybill_roll, lrcpwa, heir_estate, mcdowell_probate, or owner_name on a tax_lien/tax_sale row

atty_heir_candidates.doc: heir names or a personal representative (heir_estate, probate, SC probate, obituary survivors); applies to rows whose owner is dead or an estate

atty_rod_lien_checked.doc: a register-of-deeds instrument pull on the row (raw.rod with instrument_count, rod_docs or nc_rod)

atty_probate_case.doc: an estate file number (probate, sc_probate_notice, sc_probate_net, or a probate_notice/estate_lead row's case_number); applies to dead/estate owners

atty_tax_verified_confirmed.doc: hit = a tax_lien verdict 'confirmed'; checked = any decisive tax_lien verdict (confirmed/refuted/stale); applies to rows claiming delinquent tax

scopes.row: checked when the row carries the value or a negative-result wrapper
scopes.derived: computed from inputs already on the row: checked when the inputs are present
scopes.county: a county-wide roster/source: when it ran in the county every applicable row was screened
scopes.state: a statewide roster: when it ran anywhere in the state every applicable row was screened
scopes.feed: a listing type: the county has a feed that emits it (a scraper of that type has rows there)
